title: Pull-up for a fast I2C bus
story: An I2C bus at 3.3 V has 200 pF of wiring and pin capacitance. At t = 0 a device lets go of SDA, which starts at 0 V, and the pull-up must lift it. For fast-mode timing, SDA must pass 70% of VDD (2.31 V) within 400 ns. But a device holding the line low only has to sink 3 mA, so the pull-up current at 0 V must be 3 mA or less. Choose the pull-up.

goals.label: pull-up current at 0 V is at most 3 mA

hints: The time to reach 70% of VDD from 0 V is RC x ln(1 / 0.3) = 1.204 RC.
With C = 200 pF, 400 ns allows RC up to 332 ns, so R up to about 1.66 kohm.
With the line at 0 V the pull-up carries 3.3 V / R: R must be at least 1.1 kohm.
